1:20.sourceText: ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις

groups.note: Actual enērgēken is PERFECT ACTIVE third-singular working finite, versus primary TR aorist enērgēsen behind English he-wrought. Genuine N perfect remains, not silently harmonized to the other spelling.
Actual egeiras is AORIST ACTIVE nominative-singular raising PARTICIPLE, expanded when-he-raised without a separate source temporal conjunction/finite subject.

One genuine accusative auton identifies the same patient of the immediately coordinated raise/set predicates. KJV repeats him at both clauses; both English counterparts retain that same actual source pronoun, not a second printed Greek object.
Actual nekrōn is GENITIVE plural dead ADJECTIVE used personally, expanded the-dead without a source article/noun substitution.
Actual kathisas is AORIST ACTIVE nominative-singular seating PARTICIPLE; complete TR instead has finite ekathisen. English set keeps actual kathizō identity without hiding the N nonfinite form.
Actual dexia is DATIVE feminine singular RIGHT adjective used substantivally, expanded right-hand without a printed hand noun.

Actual autou is GENITIVE masculine singular PERSONAL pronoun in both raw fields and the same TR printed form. KJV expands his-own on the actual possessor row; no separately printed own adjective or reflexive heautou is asserted.
